title: The BEST Meta ads shortcut…
transcript: Best meta ad shortcut by far in my experience is to hire industry specific influencers to create your video ads for you. We all know how important video ads are now, and let's be honest, a lot of advertisers aren't that great at creating them. But influencers, people who have literally built followings on the back of their ability to produce video content, are fantastic at it. And they carry influence over your target market so that when they appear in the scroll, they are far more likely to grab people's attention. You can see ROSW numbers go from 2 to 6 just by changing the person in the ads and using influencers.
